_comment: Example CR13 comparison: node cr13-compare.mjs results/T1-A-checks-on.json results/T1-A-checks-off.json. Both files carry a server-verified edit_check_mode; the compare refuses a mislabeled pair. The check adds sub-millisecond latency (cached header lookup), and NFR1 holds with it ON.
cr13: cost of the per-edit write-permission check (NFR13 vs NFR1)
nfr13_note: NFR13 is verified only when NFR1 (p95 < 200 ms) holds with the check ON. Modes are server-verified.
